definitions.explanation: Boots with a blade attached to the sole, worn for gliding on ice. Includes figure skates, speed skates, and hockey skates.

examples.japanese: スケート{靴|ぐつ}を{借|か}りてリンクに{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I rented ice skates and entered the rink.

examples.japanese: スケート{靴|ぐつ}の{紐|ひも}をしっかり{結|むす}んでから{滑|すべ}ろう。
examples.english: Let's tie the skate laces tightly before we start skating.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいスケート{靴|ぐつ}は{足|あし}に{馴染|なじ}むまで{少|すこ}し{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: New ice skates take some time to break in.

notes:
Composed of スケート (skate) and {靴|くつ} (shoes/boots), with {靴|くつ} voiced to {靴|ぐつ} in the compound (rendaku). Refers specifically to ice skates in most contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スケート{靴|ぐつ}を{履|は}く: to put on ice skates
- スケート{靴|ぐつ}を{借|か}りる: to rent ice skates
- スケート{靴|ぐつ}の{刃|は}: skate blade
- スケート{靴|ぐつ}を{研|と}ぐ: to sharpen skate blades

TYPES:
- フィギュアスケート{靴|ぐつ}: figure skates
- スピードスケート{靴|ぐつ}: speed skates
- ホッケー{靴|ぐつ}: hockey skates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ローラースケート: roller skates — wheeled skates for flat surfaces
- スケート{靴|ぐつ}: this word specifically implies ice, but context may vary
